_note: Source shots for the example posts. Posts are composed in code (platform layout, captions, product UI); these are only the camera footage inside them. 'still' edits the creator's portrait so they stay the same person but in a new moment, outfit and light, never their profile picture. 'still-noref' has no person's face. Products are left blank and labeled in code. Two seeds per shot so we can pick.
style: Candid phone footage, natural light, true-to-life colors, realistic skin texture, no retouching, no text, no captions, no logos, no labels, no watermark. Not a stock photo.
